title: Head of Operations / COO
text:
### **About the Role**

A seed-stage AI company serving manufacturers is hiring a Head of Operations / COO to own day-to-day business operations. Working closely with the founders, you will connect customer delivery, supplier and freight operations, and product priorities as the business grows.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own customer onboarding, order execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and issue resolution.
* Build the processes, metrics, and playbooks needed to serve more manufacturers with a lean team.
* Work with engineering to identify which operational workflows AI agents should automate next.
* Manage supplier and freight operations, vendor relationships, and service quality.
* Hire and lead the operations team as the company grows.
* Partner with the founders on planning, finance, and company priorities.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Six to ten years of professional experience, including senior operations leadership as a Head of Operations, COO, VP or Director of Operations, or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team, with the ability to build processes from the ground up and stay hands-on.
* Strong numerical, systems, and process-design skills.
* Experience in CPG, food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, or related manufacturing, or at a company serving those industries, is useful.
* Freight brokerage or 3PL experience, or experience as a founder or early startup employee, is a plus.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Relocation within the United States is possible.
